```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_calculating_z
title: >
  Calculating z-scores
questions:
  - id: hard_math_time_z
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      For a completion time of 70 seconds in a sample with mean 100 seconds and
      standard deviation 15 seconds, what is the $z$-score?
    answer: -2
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      $z = (70 - 100) / 15 = -2$.
```
